For [bytes](/docs/shell/commands/categories/bytes/).

<div class='command-title'>Various commands for working with byte data.</div>

## Command Type

`built-in`

## Signature

```> bytes {flags} ```


## Input/output types:

| input   | output |
| ------- | ------ |
| nothing | string |
## Notes
You must use one of the following subcommands. Using this command as-is will only produce this help message.

## Subcommands:

| name                                                       | description                                                                                | type     |
| ---------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | -------- |
| [`bytes add`](/docs/shell/commands/bytes_add/)                 | Add specified bytes to the binary input.                                                   | built-in |
| [`bytes at`](/docs/shell/commands/bytes_at/)                   | Get bytes from the input defined by a range.                                               | built-in |
| [`bytes build`](/docs/shell/commands/bytes_build/)             | Create a binary value from the provided arguments.                                         | built-in |
| [`bytes collect`](/docs/shell/commands/bytes_collect/)         | Concatenate multiple binary into a single binary, with an optional separator between each. | built-in |
| [`bytes ends-with`](/docs/shell/commands/bytes_ends-with/)     | Check if binary data ends with a pattern.                                                  | built-in |
| [`bytes index-of`](/docs/shell/commands/bytes_index-of/)       | Returns start index of first occurrence of pattern in bytes, or -1 if no match.            | built-in |
| [`bytes length`](/docs/shell/commands/bytes_length/)           | Output the length of any bytes in the pipeline.                                            | built-in |
| [`bytes remove`](/docs/shell/commands/bytes_remove/)           | Remove specified bytes from the input.                                                     | built-in |
| [`bytes replace`](/docs/shell/commands/bytes_replace/)         | Find and replace bytes in binary data.                                                     | built-in |
| [`bytes reverse`](/docs/shell/commands/bytes_reverse/)         | Reverse the bytes in the pipeline.                                                         | built-in |
| [`bytes split`](/docs/shell/commands/bytes_split/)             | Split input into multiple items using a separator.                                         | built-in |
| [`bytes starts-with`](/docs/shell/commands/bytes_starts-with/) | Check if binary data starts with a pattern.                                                | built-in |
